name: PlayerSettingsComponentServerFacet_ReceiveSettingsFromClient
summary: The client's player-settings hand-off: the shared two-u64 BE head, then one u32 BE. 20-byte body, C2S. Writer and reader agree field for field and the committed 20-byte record reproduces byte for byte.
purpose: The player-settings facet hands the server the settings the client holds; the server changes its replicated player-settings state. Two of the plan's six inbound requests were already named and round-trip; this is one of the four that were refused on layout and is now recovered.

created_when: the player's settings are pushed to the server on entering a world
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the client's player settings

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 93 27, i.e. type_dec 2515. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: local_facet_id
fields.note: First u64 of the shared message head, and the sending facet's own local id - identity, not request data. The send builder fills msg+0x08 from FUN_1416c1c40(facet) = *[*[facet+8]+8] + [GDE+0x10]: [GDE+0x10] is the id handed out by the global id dispenser FUN_14144a9f0 at ClientGDE attach (writer FUN_141464890 <- FUN_14167c760), and *[*[facet+8]+8] is a base read off the object the GDE's server-GDE reference resolves to (FUN_1417db510). That same value is the key the facet registers itself under in the Context's facet map (FUN_14167c560: key FUN_1416c1c40(facet), value the facet object, slot array at Context+0x1b0) and the key the RMI dispatcher looks up, so it is the local id the server must address. The client names it itself: log field facetId, 'Failed to unregister the facet.', and on a duplicate collidingLocalId + collidingFacetName with 'We got a collision on facets IDs, RMIs may fail to be delivered to this facet.'; the dispatch failure line calls it targetLocalId. Measured 0xd1a94ccc870660b0 on the 2026-10-20 18:38 record, a value no other facet in that session shares.

fields.name: local_actor_id_word0
fields.note: Second u64 of the shared message head, and the first 8 bytes of the client's own actor id - identity, not request data. Writer FUN_1414dbca0 copies the message object's +0x10 through a stack local and writes it big-endian (htonl64 FUN_1461668a0) through the stream raw-write slot +0x40. The send builder fills +0x10 from FUN_1416be9f0, which dereferences the weak handle at the GDE's +0x60 (FUN_14165c230) and reads [session+0x88]. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in all 14 committed bodies of the six head-prefixed messages across five sessions; in the same records its little-endian bytes 1a954abc4b3185bf are the first 8 of the record's 16-byte actor id, the local player's actor id handed over by ClientAddEntryMsg (0xa4).

fields.name: field_c
fields.note: One u32 BE written by FUN_140876e70 (htonl FUN_146166830) from the message object at +0x20 and read by FUN_14087a3c0. Meaning unnamed. Body offset 0x10.

This wire's builder FUN_142a5c250 (sole caller FUN_142a644e0) fills +0x08 with FUN_1416c1c40(...) and +0x10 with *FUN_1416be9f0(...) = [session+0x88].
